en.html:
The warrior's orthodox high guard. With that I would stay, right to the end.
From that stance, the greatest striking force. Hence orthodox. Hence the proper course to take.

Some trick of the enemy's, and I should abandon it in fear?
Finish the fight with this stroke. Then where was the problem?

A gap in the plating. Aim there, and drive it in!

あくまでも武者正調の上段を貫く。
　この構えからの一撃こそ最大の打撃力を有する。故
に正調、常道なのだ。

　敵の奇手を恐れて、常道を曲げるべきではない。
　この一撃で勝負を決すれば済む話だ。

　甲鉄の隙間を狙い、一刀を叩き込む！

no effect at all! The thickest part of the plating. The sword struck and merely bounced off.

The enemy had not taken so much as a wound.
And that meant————
